messages.content: For this planning task, keep these fixed inputs: there are 6 batches, each batch holds 25 pages, and 40 cover pages must be added to any total.
Noted as fixed inputs: batches = 6, pages per batch = 25, cover pages to add = 40.
So how many pages in total on the batches?
With 6 batches and 25 pages each, that is 6 × 25 = 150. (the old printer's 32-page batches mentioned earlier is a separate matter.)
Now include the cover pages from our fixed inputs. What is the running total?
Running total is 150 + 40 = 190. (the old printer's 32-page batches mentioned earlier is a separate matter.)
Before we finish, restate our running numbers so far.
Running numbers: batches 6, pages per batch 25, subtotal 150, total 190. (the old printer's 32-page batches mentioned earlier is a separate matter.)
Using our fixed inputs, state the total number of pages (from the batches plus the cover pages) as a single number. End your reply with the number alone on the last line.
